messages.text: Hi, my reading lamp still hasn't arrived. Can you tell me where it is?

Your reading lamp’s order is marked as **shipped**, but I can’t see its precise location. This refund process only covers delivered orders; cancelling or changing delivery is outside it. Would you like a staff member to help with the delivery? (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders)
